no its fine i mean. its not a big deal its just like. theres this thing at work. its dumb

ok so like. my manager left right. and instead of replacing her they just sort of. handed me her stuff. on top of my stuff. but nobody actually SAID anything its just sort of assumed now lol classic
That sounds really pressured — like it got piled onto you without anyone actually naming it. Does it feel more like rushed, trapped, or just overloaded?
i dunno man. all of them? lol. i guess overloaded. like i open my laptop and theres just. so much. and half of it isnt even mine its just hers that became mine somehow
Yeah — overloaded, with your laptop turning into this pile of both yours and hers. Does it make you want to speed up, shut down, or get out from under it?

honestly? shut down. like ill sit there at 11pm just staring at it not doing anything which is the worst because then nothing gets done and im still up. but if i say something ill look like i cant handle it you know

the second one i think. ugh. like the work is whatever, work is always too much. its more that i feel like if i admit its too much then thats it, im the one who couldnt do it. she did all this AND made it look easy and im over here drowning at her old desk lol
